BiblicalUsage: Aziza was one of the sons of Zattu who had taken a foreign wife, and he put her away in the days of Ezra's reform. His name appears once, in the long list of those who set their houses right.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ezra's list is hard reading, and Aziza's name in it reminds me that repentance sometimes costs a household everything.
